intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. My flagship applications built on one shared House Frontend design system are OpenRO v1.14.0 (single-binary Rust Studio Copilot 3-pane Roblox Studio AI IDE with 9.93 MB binary -11.0% / -47.7% vs v1.1.0, 57.7 KB gzip shell, 39.40ms cold boot -93.3% vs v1.8.0, 16.29 MB RSS -85.8% vs v1.2.0, Preflight Hook-Integrity & Surgical Restore Guard, Playable Snapshot Diff & Safe Rollback, Luau Dependency Graph Pruner, Studio Economy Simulator, OpenRoCompanion.lua Studio plugin, all 13 MCP tools, 33/33 fuzz, and 3,880 req/s +11.0% with 5.33ms p95 -11.0%), OpenBell v0.9.0 (Institutional Quant Terminal for Kalshi Trade API v2 with 1-click Full Quant Edge Audit 5-stage Go/No-Go funnel, causal lookahead-canary tests, fail-closed Hard Risk Rails disarmed on every boot, Emergency Kill Switch, Out-of-Sample Strategy Tournament, PAV Isotonic Calibration, and $500/Day Capital Scaling Engine), and Fleet v1.12.0 (Antigravity-native Swarm Sidebar Plugin with 1-Click Gate Readiness Card, Per-Worker Token Burn Guard Strip, Multi-Worker Broadcast Composer & Filtered Board Export, Swarm Bottleneck Heat Bar & Copy Blocker, Inline Worktree Diff Peek & CWE-22/59 confinement, 91.66 KiB gz, 69.16 MB --jitless RSS -67.4%, 1,039 req/s, and 30/30 fuzz; legacy standalone Rust v0.12.0 preserved in git), alongside Ergon v0.24.0 (single-binary Rust Claude-Desktop employee desk with 8.48 MB binary -3.5% / -47.0% vs v0.10.0, 17.37ms boot, 16.48 MB RSS -5.1%, 6,090.8 req/s +16.5% at 3.37ms p95 -1.2%, Learned Memory Health & Stale-Reference Guard, Scheduled Routine Catch-Up & SHA-256 Badge, Batch Citation Freshness Gate, Playbook Dry-Run Preview, Verified Playbook Packs, and 33/33 fuzz).
